items.title: ハマス最高指導者の息子、イスラエル軍の暗殺攻撃から生存＝幹部
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２７日 ロイター] - イスラム組織ハマスの幹部バシム・ナイム氏は、最高指導者ハリル・ハイヤ氏の息子が２７日、イスラエル軍による暗殺未遂を免れたと明らかにした。

ナイム氏はロイターに対し、ハリル氏の息子イゼルディン・ハイヤ氏とその家族が早朝の空爆を生き延びたと述べた。また、ハマス筋によると、イゼルディン氏の妻を含む数人が負傷したが、死者は出なかったという。 

イスラエル軍は直ちにコメントを出していない。

ナイム氏によると、イゼルディン・ハイヤ氏はハリル氏にとって唯一存命の息子で、他の４人の息子はいずれもイスラエル軍によって殺害されたという。

ハリル氏は前日２６日、パレスチナ自治区ガザでイスラエルの攻撃により、ハマスが任命した教育副大臣を含む少なくとも１０人が死亡したことを受け、イスラエルによる攻撃が続く状況を受け入れるつもりはないとし、報復の可能性を示唆した。

Nov 27 : Bayern Munich midfielder Jamal Musiala faces another spell on the sidelines after sustaining a right hamstring injury, the club said on Friday, a week after he returned from a lengthy layoff.
The 23-year-old Germany international came on in the 76th minute of Wednesday's 2-1 Champions League defeat at Lille, having made his comeback in last week's 1-1 Bundesliga draw with Cologne after being out with a hamstring injury in September.
Bayern said their medical team had confirmed the muscular injury and Musiala would be sidelined "until further notice". Reuters has asked the club for a timeline for his return.
Musiala had missed much of last season after breaking his leg during the 2025 Club World Cup but returned to play for Germany at this year's World Cup.

The latest setback comes amid scrutiny of Bayern's handling of the midfielder's neurological disorder, which he revealed in August after collapsing in two matches.
Bayern said on Wednesday that Musiala was first examined for neurological symptoms in April 2025, more than 16 months before he announced his diagnosis.
The club held talks with Musiala's representatives this week following comments from senior officials, including honorary president Uli Hoeness and board member Karl-Heinz Rummenigge, about his future and if he could return to the highest level.
Global players' union FIFPRO strongly criticised the remarks.
"For both parties, the player's health is the absolute priority. Jamal Musiala will receive full support throughout his recovery process," Bayern said after the talks.
Musiala signed a contract extension until 2030 in February 2025.
Bayern visit Hamburg in the Bundesliga on Saturday, seeking to respond to their first defeat of the season at Lille.

Source: Reuters

Nov 27 : Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca said there was no panic over his side's recent slump ahead of Sunday's Premier League clash at Arsenal, saying that a dip in form was a natural part of the club's transition following Pep Guardiola's departure.
City have taken one point from their last four league matches after starting with seven straight wins. They are in third place, level on 22 points with second-placed Brighton & Hove Albion and six behind leaders Arsenal.
Maresca, appointed in June after manager Guardiola's decade-long spell in charge of City came to an end, said the team's inconsistency was to be expected during a period of change.
"Transition requires time. It's probably because we won seven games in a row, with Champions League eight in a row. Everyone was thinking at City there's no transition," Maresca told a press conference on Friday.

"But I've said many times I'm not a magician. There is transition, it's normal. There are eight or nine new players, the manager is new. So you need time. And you can see, with different clubs when they had transition, how complicated it is.
"I'm completely relaxed, no panic at all. I understand that we need to win games because it's our business but, for me, it's all normal."
Maresca also played down concerns over Erling Haaland's mood after the Norway striker, who tops the league scoring charts with nine goals, said earlier this week that City's poor run had left players questioning themselves.
"I think Erling is a winner. It's normal that he's not happy when we don't win games, but not just Erling, everyone," Maresca said. "Remember, just a few weeks ago, he was dancing inside the pitch. You can write and think many different things.
"Erling is upset. I'm upset because we're not winning games. But this is our job, this is football. That's why I need to maintain the balance."
The scrutiny surrounding City's form has been heightened by the uncertainty hanging over the club after an independent commission in September found them guilty of 114 breaches of Premier League financial rules. City are appealing the verdict and have denied any wrongdoing.
There was better news on the injury front, however, with Maresca saying forward Antoine Semenyo is nearing a return after suffering a knee injury in October.
"He's already on the pitch, he's very close. Hopefully, it can be next week," Maresca added.

Source: Reuters

Nov 27 : Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola warned his players that form and league position would count for nothing in the heat of Sunday's Merseyside derby against Everton.
Iraola, preparing for his first taste of the fixture, experienced the intensity of local rivalries while playing for Athletic Bilbao against Real Sociedad and said derbies demanded a different level of competitiveness.
"I haven't lived this derby, but it doesn't take a lot when you're here to perceive that it's a big game for everyone involved," Iraola told reporters on Friday.
"It's a derby and derbies are always different. It doesn't matter where you are in the standings, the run you are in, normally the type of game is different and you can feel it from the beginning," he added.

"We have to be very competitive, do our part, win our duels. We have to be at a good level because everyone will want to win this game."
Liverpool head into the match on the back of three straight wins in all competitions and sit fourth in the Premier League with 21 points from 11 matches, seven points behind leaders Arsenal.
Everton are ninth, five points behind their Merseyside rivals and were comfortably beaten 4-0 by Brentford in their last outing.
Iraola said derby results carried a significance that lingered long after the final whistle, leaving victory as the only route to an enjoyable occasion.
"I'm very happy to be part of it and I hope I enjoy it," he said. "There's only one way to enjoy it and that's to win the game."
Winger Victor Munoz, who was forced off during Liverpool’s Champions League win at Club Brugge, avoided a serious injury but remains a doubt for Sunday, Iraola said. Cody Gakpo is still sidelined with a muscle injury.

Nov 27 : The US Federal Communications Commission authorised Elon Musk's SpaceX on Wednesday to deploy 1 million satellites to support data centres in space, a fleet that would dwarf the total number of active satellites currently orbiting Earth.
The FCC said it was approving the SpaceX Starmind constellation to help meet rapidly growing demand for AI computing.
SpaceX's Starlink pioneered the era of large satellite networks, known as megaconstellations, with rivals including Amazon and Chinese operators developing similar systems.
But putting satellites into orbit on the scale envisaged by Starmind would take the boom to a new level, intensifying concerns among scientists about space junk, atmospheric pollution and the transformation of the night sky.

SpaceX did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment on this story early in the US day.
Here are some environmental questions surrounding projects such as Starmind:
WHAT WOULD 1 MILLION SATELLITES MEAN FOR THE ENVIRONMENT?
Scientists and regulators disagree over how much environmental damage Starmind could cause and how much can be known before the satellites, each with a wingspan of 75 metres (246 feet), begin flying.
In a recent study, University College London researchers estimated that 1 million satellites could increase emissions from launches and re-entries by roughly 70 to 150 times from current levels.
They said the resulting emissions could affect ozone, climate and air quality, and that SpaceX's filing lacked the information needed to fully assess those risks.
The FCC, however, said those questions largely fell outside its remit.
"Potential concerns related to the emissions of rocket launches and the subsequent impacts on the human environment as an indirect result of the Starmind system are outside of the Commission’s purview," the regulator said.
It also dismissed concerns about satellites burning up in the atmosphere as insufficiently established.
"Other concerns, including impacts on the atmosphere caused by satellites burning up on re-entry, remain speculative and not supported in the record," the FCC said.
WOULD SPACE JUNK INCREASE?
Almost certainly.
Low-Earth orbit, where Starlink and the proposed Starmind satellites would operate, is already becoming increasingly congested, and experts say the amount of debris there would probably keep rising even if all space activity stopped today.
As of February 1, there were more than 231 million debris objects in orbit measuring between 1 millimetre and 10 centimetres (4 inches), according to the European Space Agency, which has repeatedly called for measures to reduce collision risks.
SpaceX told regulators in a later submission in response to the FCC that it would initially deploy satellites at lower altitudes for testing before moving them higher. It said onboard propulsion would enable collision-avoidance manoeuvres, station-keeping — keeping satellites in their assigned positions — and eventual deorbiting.
The company also said it would continue refining satellite designs to reduce collision risks and use controlled re-entries aimed over oceans. SpaceX said its satellites would be designed to burn up completely during re-entry.
But the sheer number of satellites changes the calculation.
University of Birmingham professor Hugh Lewis said even a failure rate of 1 per cent could leave thousands of derelict satellites in orbit each year, which could increase the risk of collisions.
WHAT WOULD HAPPEN TO THE NIGHT SKY?
Scientists say it could change dramatically. 
Following the FCC's approval, the American Astronomical Society said the proposed constellation would undermine decades of public investment in astronomical facilities and impair scientists' ability to study the universe. 
Lewis said some of the Starmind satellites would be in "sun-synchronous" orbits and would always be illuminated, adding that they could contaminate astronomical images.
Visual simulations shared online by Virginia Tech aerospace professor Shane Ross show bands of satellites stretching across large portions of the sky, potentially outnumbering visible stars.
The FCC rejected requests for additional conditions, saying protection of optical astronomy falls largely outside its rules and that SpaceX's commitment to coordinate with the US National Science Foundation was sufficient.
IS IT REALISTIC TO SEND 1 MILLION SATELLITES TO SPACE?   
Not quickly. It would be impossible for SpaceX to launch 1 million satellites at the same time. The largest number of payloads carried by a single SpaceX rocket is 143. 
Satellite operators sometimes request approval for higher numbers of satellites than they intend to deploy to buy design flexibility.
For example, SpaceX sought approval for 42,000 Starlink satellites before it began deployment of that system. The growing network currently has just over 11,000 satellites in space.
The FCC authorisation requires the company to place its first Starmind satellite into orbit by November 2033, have half in orbit by 2038 and complete deployment by 2040. No operator has ever sent 1 million objects into space.
The proposed network is central to Musk's vision of moving energy-intensive AI computing into orbit with solar-powered data centres. However, SpaceX itself told investors ahead of its stock market listing that the ambition to build space-based data centres relied on unproven technology and may not be commercially viable.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Bank of America anticipa dos buenas noticias para Colombia que abrirían la puerta a bajar las tasas
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: Carlos Capistrán, jefe de Economía para América Latina y Canadá de Bank of America, considera que la combinación de una corrección de las finanzas públicas y el respaldo del multilateral podría abrir ...
items.body: Bogotá — Colombia podría entrar en un círculo virtuoso de ajuste fiscal y reducción de las tasas de interés en 2027 si consigue avanzar en la corrección de sus finanzas públicas y materializar un paquete de ayuda del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI), según Bank of America. “La dirección es la correcta”, aseguró Carlos Capistrán, Managing Director y jefe de Economía para América Latina y Canadá de Bank of America, en entrevista con Bloomberg Línea. El economista compartió el optimismo del equipo del banco respecto a las perspectivas de Colombia, aunque reconoció que todavía existen interrogantes sobre la magnitud del ajuste fiscal que conseguirá aprobar el Gobierno en el Congreso. Bank of America participó en la Milagro Week, la estrategia de promoción de inversiones que llevó a las autoridades colombianas a Nueva York y que incluyó encuentros en las instalaciones de la entidad financiera estadounidense. Capistrán destacó que uno de los elementos que sustentan el optimismo del banco sobre Colombia es el paquete de ajuste fiscal, pese a que su composición ha cambiado frente a las expectativas iniciales. La propuesta contempla una menor participación de los recortes del gasto público y una mayor contribución de los ingresos del Gobierno a la corrección del desequilibrio de las finanzas públicas. El economista reconoció que el alcance de las medidas “puede diluirse en el Congreso”, aunque Bank of America mantiene su expectativa de que Colombia conseguirá avanzar en el ajuste. El segundo elemento que respalda la visión favorable de la entidad financiera es la posibilidad de que el país consiga un paquete de ayuda del Fondo Monetario Internacional. “Nosotros creemos que se anunciará dentro de muy poco”, afirmó Capistrán sobre el eventual respaldo del organismo multilateral. La combinación de ambos acontecimientos, aunque todavía esté por definirse el tamaño de la corrección fiscal, podría generar condiciones más favorables para la política monetaria colombiana. Bank of America considera que los avances en materia fiscal y el potencial respaldo del FMI podrían darle margen de maniobra al Banco de la República para comenzar a reducir las tasas de interés durante 2027. Capistrán recordó que el emisor colombiano actualmente está subiendo las tasas y enfrentando los efectos del Fenómeno de El Niño. Sin embargo, la materialización de los dos acontecimientos podría permitir que el banco central encuentre espacio para iniciar los recortes desde el segundo trimestre del próximo año. Colombia podría conseguir así una “reducción de tasas de interés reales”, explicó el economista. Capistrán distinguió dos caminos para reducir las tasas de interés reales: uno mediante la corrección de los desequilibrios fiscales, que permite a los bancos centrales flexibilizar su política monetaria, y otro mediante el aumento de la inflación. “Si sólo intentas bajar las tasas de interés sin arreglar tu problema fiscal, eso usualmente no acaba bien”, advirtió al analizar los desafíos que enfrentan las economías latinoamericanas. El economista puso como ejemplo a Argentina, donde el ajuste fiscal impulsado por el Gobierno de Javier Milei abrió espacio para reducir las tasas de interés y consiguió avances importantes en la disminución de la inflación. El optimismo de Bank of America respecto a Colombia contrasta con la cautela que mantiene la entidad frente a Brasil, donde las incertidumbres fiscales han acompañado la depreciación de su moneda, pese a las elevadas tasas de interés. “No estamos muy constructivos actualmente en Brasil”, afirmó Capistrán. Para la mayor economía latinoamericana, el banco anticipa una combinación de bajo crecimiento, altas tasas de interés y riesgos adicionales para su moneda. El economista advirtió que una mayor desaceleración de la actividad económica brasileña podría incrementar los riesgos fiscales si el Gobierno intenta contrarrestarla mediante un aumento del gasto público. En México, entretanto, la preocupación está relacionada con la necesidad de cumplir los compromisos de reducción del déficit para minimizar los riesgos sobre su grado de inversión. Estos desafíos se presentan en un entorno de condiciones financieras internacionales más restrictivas, marcado por los incrementos de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal y de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense. Capistrán también señaló que el crecimiento económico de América Latina sigue siendo bajo, en momentos en que las tasas de interés están aumentando. Durante la entrevista, el jefe de Economía para América Latina y Canadá de Bank of America también abordó los desafíos que enfrenta la región para aprovechar las grandes inversiones en sectores productivos. Aunque destacó los efectos positivos de la llegada de capitales, cuestionó que los gobiernos utilicen los ingresos adicionales derivados de esas inversiones para financiar aumentos del gasto en consumo. “Lo ideal es utilizar esos nuevos recursos para tratar de invertir en crecimiento”, aseguró. Capistrán destacó la importancia de destinar esos ingresos extraordinarios a infraestructura y proyectos que complementen las inversiones privadas, de manera que sus beneficios puedan extenderse al resto de la economía. “La experiencia de Latinoamérica no ha sido muy buena en eso”, reconoció, aunque destacó que algunos países han mostrado un mayor interés por invertir en infraestructura. En cuanto a las perspectivas del petróleo para 2027, Bank of America anticipa una reducción de los precios, con un Brent que llegaría a niveles cercanos a los US$80 por barril, aunque reconoce que existe “muchísima incertidumbre” alrededor de ese pronóstico.

items.title: Galicia revela cuánto podría bajar la mora en 2027: el repunte que ve en préstamos
items.author: Francisco Aldaya
items.summary: El CFO del holding argentino, Gonzalo Fernández Covaro, proyectó ante analistas un ROE de dos dígitos bajos para el año próximo, un margen financiero en torno a 15% y menos chances de un salto de tasa ...
items.body: Buenos Aires — Grupo Financiero Galicia ( GGAL ) espera que su cartera irregular baje a entre 7,5% y 7,8% del total de préstamos hacia fines de 2027, desde 9,7% al cierre del tercer trimestre, y que sus préstamos crezcan entre 5% y 10% en términos reales el año próximo, dijo el CFO Gonzalo Fernández Covaro en la conferencia con analistas del miércoles. “Vemos que nuestra mora va a seguir mejorando”, dijo Fernández Covaro, aun si la economía argentina crece menos que el 2% que proyecta el grupo, el mayor holding financiero del país por activos totales. El costo del riesgo bajaría unos 200 puntos básicos frente a este año, agregó. Pablo Firvida, responsable de relaciones con inversores, había aclarado en la presentación que la entidad mantiene la cautela. “Los niveles de mora todavía están por encima de los registrados un año atrás y la mejora debe sostenerse durante varios trimestres”, dijo. VER MÁS: Grupo Financiero Galicia vuelve al verde y baja la mora en el tercer trimestre Galicia reportó el martes una ganancia neta atribuible de ARS$229.002 millones en el tercer trimestre, por encima de los ARS$218.663 millones del consenso de Bloomberg, con lo que revirtió la pérdida de ARS$116.964 millones de un año atrás, aunque el resultado fue 16% menor al del segundo trimestre. La cartera irregular bajó a 9,7% desde 10,6% en el trimestre previo, todavía por encima del 6,9% de 2025, y el margen financiero cayó a 14,4% desde 17,9%. Los préstamos netos sumaron ARS$28,1 billones, 3% menos que en junio y 8% menos que un año antes. En Banco Galicia, la principal unidad del grupo, la mora cerraría 2026 en torno a 7% y 2027 entre 5,5% y 6%, frente a 7,8% en septiembre, según el CFO. Para el grupo, que incluye a Naranja X, anticipó un cierre de este año de entre 8,5% y 8,8%. La mejora se apoya en que el banco endureció sus políticas de originación y dejó de prestarles a algunos segmentos, explicó. Consultado sobre si el costo del riesgo del grupo podría bajar a 7%, respondió que eso “es optimista” y que lo ve “más bien en torno a 8% u 8,5%”. La cobertura con previsiones, lo que el banco aparta por si los créditos no se devuelven, llegaría a 100% a fin de año. Los castigos de cartera -un registro contable por el cual un banco retira de sus activos un crédito con mora prolongada que considera de improbable recuperación-, que más que se triplicaron en el trimestre según un analista de Latin Securities, se mantendrán en el nivel actual. El banco extendió de 270 a 365 días el plazo para dar de baja un crédito, lo que redujo la cifra del segundo trimestre, explicó Fernández Covaro. La mora de las pymes, una cartera chica para la entidad, muestra una estabilización y mejoraría el año próximo. VER MÁS: Senado argentino aprueba suspender las PASO y el proyecto pasa a Diputados El crédito cerraría el 2026 con un alza de alrededor de 5% real si se sostiene el repunte de la demanda en pesos que el banco vio en octubre. Para 2027, el CFO prevé un crecimiento de préstamos y depósitos de entre 5% y 10%, “más cerca de 10%”. La demanda actual es de corto plazo, para capital de trabajo y descuento de cheques, sin cambios significativos en proyectos de largo plazo, describió. Los préstamos personales crecen “lenta pero consistentemente” mes a mes. El año próximo el crédito en pesos avanzaría más que el denominado en dólares, porque en un año electoral todo el sistema querrá conservar más liquidez en esa moneda. En Naranja X, la cartera se achicó por el menor apetito de riesgo y una demanda débil, dijo el CFO de la unidad fintech, Hernán García. El banco digital espera para 2027 un crecimiento real de 5% en préstamos personales y una cartera de tarjetas sin cambios, con una reversión de tendencia recién en el segundo semestre. Fernández Covaro ve menos probabilidades de que se repita el salto de tasas previo a las elecciones legislativas de 2025, porque el Banco Central (BCRA) tiene más reservas y otras herramientas para sostener la estabilidad cambiaria. “Es imposible garantizar que no vaya a pasar, pero vemos menos chances”, dijo. La incertidumbre política es, a su vez, el principal riesgo a la baja para su proyección de crecimiento del PBI de entre 1,8% y 2%. VER MÁS: Banco Macro revierte su pérdida neta del 2025 pero sube la mora y ceden sus préstamos Sobre una eventual recompra de acciones, que cotizan a 0,7 veces su valor libro según un analista de Adcap, respondió que el holding casi no tiene liquidez. Sin embargo, el grupo analizará dejar parte de los próximos dividendos de la sociedad controlante para ese fin. A Mercado Pago, que obtuvo licencia bancaria, Galicia lo toma “muy en serio como un competidor importante”, dijo el CFO. La regulación común empareja las condiciones, y la ventaja del grupo está en los segmentos medios y medios altos, que demandan productos más sofisticados, sostuvo. Así se mueven las acciones de Grupo Galicia. Símbolo: GGAL:AR. Clase de activo: equity. El grupo cerraría 2026 con un ROE de alrededor de 8% y espera para 2027 un retorno “en el rango bajo de los dos dígitos”, un paso hacia el 15% que proyecta para 2028. Si desaparece el ajuste contable por inflación, el objetivo desde 2029 es de entre 15% y 20%, dijo Fernández Covaro. El margen financiero terminaría este año en 16% y se ubicaría entre 15% y 15,5% en 2027, por encima del 14,4% del tercer trimestre. Parte de la caída reciente se explica por la composición de la cartera, con más préstamos en dólares y más crédito comercial, que tienen menores márgenes, explicó. La proyección no contempla ganancias por venta de bonos.

items.title: CRTC says Bell, Telus and Rogers violated its ban on junk fees
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada’s telecommunications regulator has determined the Big Three providers violated its rules banning so-called junk fees and is ordering the companies to remove those charges by Dec. 27.
items.body: Canada’s telecommunications regulator has determined the Big Three providers violated its rules banning so-called junk fees and is ordering the companies to remove those charges by Dec. 27. The CRTC issued a ruling Friday saying that carriers violated its prohibition on charging a fee for providing and setting up cellphones when signing up for a service plan. The regulator previously said the companies could face monetary penalties of up to $10 million while relevant managers could be penalized up to $25,000. The CRTC launched a review in June, requiring Bell Canada, Telus Corp. and Rogers Communications Inc. to demonstrate their fees do not contravene its policy. The new regulations came into effect June 12 prohibiting activation, modification and cancellation fees in a bid to make it easier for customers to switch internet and cellphone plans without having to worry about unexpected costs. At the time, the CRTC warned each of the companies over their recently introduced fees, saying the charges did not appear to qualify for an exemption to the new policy meant for optional services or equipment customers choose to purchase. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 27, 2026. Sammy Hudes, The Canadian Press BNN Bloomberg, CTV News and CP24 are owned by Bell Media, which is a division of BCE.

DOHA, Nov 27 : Newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli stood out above the rest as he led George Russell in a Mercedes one-two in first practice for the Qatar Grand Prix on Friday.
The 20-year-old Italian lapped the floodlit circuit with a best time of one minute 23.217 seconds on the medium tyre with Russell 0.507 slower on the theoretically faster softs.
Red Bull's Isack Hadjar was third fastest in a warm evening session at Lusail and McLaren's 2025 Formula One champion Lando Norris fourth, one hundredth of a second quicker than teammate Oscar Piastri in fifth.
"The Mercedes are hugely fast, Antonelli looks to be in a class of his own," Alpine's managing director Steve Nielsen told Sky Sports television.

Max Verstappen, winner of three of four Qatar Grands Prix to date, was sixth fastest and 0.916 slower than Antonelli.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were seventh and eighth, with Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad ninth and Alpine's Pierre Gasly 10th.
"Did other people have degradation? Because mine is massive," asked Hamilton over the team radio. "Yes, we confirm much higher than expected on all compounds," came the reply.  
Pirelli have prepared for that already, with teams limited to 27 laps per set and the race sure to be at least a two-stopper. 
Hadjar had an anxious moment when he was cleared to leave the pits with a mechanic still busy with the rear left tyre. The mechanic jumped away and was unhurt. 
Stewards said they would investigate a possible unsafe release after the session.

FAST

Nov 27 : An international team of marine geologists using a remotely operated submarine in an abyss in the western Pacific Ocean has found evidence of the deepest-known explosive volcanic eruption on Earth as much as 4 miles (6,500 meters) below the surface.
The researchers sailed to the Mariana Trench, among the deepest oceanic valleys on the planet, to deploy a remotely operated vehicle, or ROV, called Jason/Medea. They used the ROV to study the trench walls around the deepest-known point of seabed on Earth, called the Challenger Deep.
The ROV observed and collected pyroclastic rocks, telltale evidence of an explosive volcanic eruption composed of ejected rock fragments and volcanic glass.
"The key findings are the discovery of recent igneous activity near the trench," said geologist Robert Stern, a professor emeritus at the University of Texas at Dallas and a visiting researcher at UCLA who is the lead author of a study describing the findings in the journal Frontiers in Earth Science.

"Pyroclastic rocks are well known from volcanic eruptions on land and even in the shallow ocean, but they aren't known from as deep as we discovered them," Stern said.
The Mariana Trench formed as part of a process called plate tectonics involving the inexorable movement of continent-scale plates on Earth's surface. The trench is the surface manifestation of a subduction zone, the boundary where one plate dives beneath another plate.
The surface above the subduction zone typically has big volcanoes, but these are generally located about 125 to 185 miles (200 to 300 km) from the trench. The pyroclastic rocks that the researchers discovered were in the trench itself.
The ROV explored along 340 miles (550 km) of a geological structure called a forearc that is part of the upper plate between the trench and a line of volcanoes on the seafloor, near the Challenger Deep.
"The ROV was our principal research tool used for looking at and collecting samples from the seafloor down to 6,500 meters (4 miles)," Stern said. "We had a total of 10 dives, 7 of which were in the forearc around the Challenger Deep. The other 3 were in shallower waters near Guam because of weather conditions."
The rocks collected by the ROV contained broken pieces of rock and volcanic glass cemented in a relatively strong matrix of finer-grained material.
"This is unmistakably the product of a volcanic eruption. We did not see any eruption, and we have not yet found the vents from which the pyroclastic rocks erupted," Stern said.
The age of the rocks is not yet known, but they appear to be recent, in geological terms, Stern said.
The researchers are trying to understand how these explosive eruptions occurred at such depths, considering the vast water pressure at the volcanic sites.
"The intense pressures at the depths that these submarine volcanoes erupted makes the eruption style different than it would be on land or in shallow water, where the pressures are much lower," Stern said.

Source: Reuters

"This is unmistakably the product of a volcanic eruption. We did not see any eruption, and we have not yet found the vents from which the pyroclastic rocks erupted," Stern said.
The age of the rocks is not yet known, but they appear to be recent, in geological terms, Stern said.
The researchers are trying to understand how these explosive eruptions occurred at such depths, considering the vast water pressure at the volcanic sites.
"The intense pressures at the depths that these submarine volcanoes erupted makes the eruption style different than it would be on land or in shallow water, where the pressures are much lower," Stern said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Bonos y acciones argentinos vuelan por triunfos legislativos de Milei y viento de cola de Brasil
items.author: Juan Pablo Álvarez
items.summary: El riesgo país perforó a la baja los 1.000 puntos y trae algo de calma financiera, luego de días de fuertes caídas.
items.body: Buenos Aires — Luego de un noviembre marcado por duras caídas, los bonos y las acciones argentinas comienzan la rueda de este viernes con subas auspiciosas. El rebote llega tras una serie de victorias legislativas del Gobierno de Javier Milei, entre ellas la eliminación de las PASO, la reforma de la Carta Orgánica del Banco Central (BCRA) y la media sanción del Presupuesto 2027, mientras que se suma a un viento de cola proveniente de Brasil, luego de que Lula da Silva anunciara al actual presidente de Bradesco, Luiz Carlos Trabuco, como ministro de Hacienda. VER MAS: Galicia revela cuánto podría bajar la mora en 2027: el repunte que ve en préstamos El mercado interpretaba esa designación como una señal de prudencia para empezar a resolver la delicada situación fiscal de Brasil, provocando una fuerte apreciación del real. Ese fortalecimiento de la moneda del país vecino le quita presión bajista al peso argentino. En este contexto, el riesgo país cae a 946 puntos a las 12:00hs de Buenos Aires, luego tocado picos superiores a los 1.100 puntos en esta semana. En tanto, los principales ADR argentinos rebotan en Wall Street: YPF SA ( YPFD ) avanza 4,23% y Grupo Financiero Galicia ( GGAL ) suben más de 7,13%. VER MÁS: Nubank, el real y los activos brasileños se disparan con el nuevo ministro de Hacienda de Lula Así se mueven a esta hora los bonos argentinos emitidos bajo jurisdicción extranjera: De todas formas, se encaminan a cerrar el mes con pérdidas de hasta 7%, aunque varía dependiendo el tramo de la curva (la más castigada fue la parte corta). Buena parte del empuje está vinculado al mejor ánimo del mercado respecto de Brasil: de hecho, el EWZ (es decir, el ETF de acciones brasileñas) sube cerca de 14% tras el giro ortodoxo anunciado por el gobierno de la principal economía de la región. En tanto, el bono brasileño a 10 años avanza 2%.

items.title: トランプ氏「イラク首相の取り組み支持」、国家統制強化で原油密輸阻止
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２７日、イラクのザイディ首相が進める同国産原油の密輸阻止を含む、国家統制強化の取り組みを支持する姿勢を示した。ザイディ氏によるこうした一連の動きは、イランの民兵組織やクルド当局との直接対立を招いている。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「イラク全土で国家権限を確立し、イラク産原油の密輸を阻止し、汚職を一掃し、全ての武器を国家の独占的な管理下に置くというザイディ首相の取り組みを支持する」と表明した。

イラク国営通信社によると、この投稿は、イラクのアブディ報道官が、国営石油販売会社（ＳＯＭＯ）を経由しない原油輸出は、その収益が国庫に入らないため密輸と見なすとの見解を示した直後に出された。

アブディ氏は、イラクは２００８年から２５年にかけて、同国北部クルディスタン地域を経由した石油密輸により推計１０００億ドルを失ったと述べた。

政府がこの数字をどのように算出したかは明らかでない。

イラクは２６日、ザイディ氏が連邦当局に対し、半自治的な地域行政が運営する国境検問所の管理を引き継ぐよう命じたことを受け、クルディスタン地域にあるシリアとの国境検問所とイランとの国境検問所の２カ所を閉鎖した。

数千人のクルド人が同日、油田を連邦政府の管理下に置き、同地域の国境沿いに連邦軍を展開しようとするザイディ氏の動きに抗議した。

Mumbai’s civic authority, India’s richest, plans to tap individual investors through future bond sales to help finance urban infrastructure projects.

“We want to open it for the retail investors as well,” Ashwini Bhide, commissioner of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, said at an event Friday. “Mumbaikars can very well participate in the whole growth story of Mumbai.”

Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government is encouraging local bodies to raise funds for roads, bridges and sewerage systems through bonds, as India seeks to develop a municipal debt market along the lines of the US. Public offerings of municipal bonds remain rare in India, with most such debt sold privately to institutional investors.

Show Full Article

The corporation overseeing India’s financial capital plans to raise as much as 95 billion rupees ($1 billion) through municipal or green municipal bonds in one or more tranches, Bloomberg News reported earlier.

Large institutional investors are expected to subscribe to BMC’s offering, which is set to launch soon, Bhide said. The authority would go for a public sale of bonds slowly in future issuances, she said.

Municipal bodies raised 10 billion rupees in local-currency debt in 2025, the most in at least nine years, according to data from the regulator going back to 2017. Around 7.6 billion rupees of notes have been issued so far this year.

MANCHESTER, England, Nov 27 : Manchester United have exercised the one-year option in captain Bruno Fernandes's contract, extending his deal until June 2028, a team source said on Friday.
The source said the move suited both parties and left the door open to future talks over a new contract, although the immediate priority was improving results.
United are languishing in 19th place in the Premier League after their worst start to a top-flight season in 40 years.
Fernandes, however, is a doubt for Saturday's Premier League clash with sixth-placed Brentford after missing Friday's training session because of a virus.

The 32-year-old, who signed his previous contract in August 2024, scored both goals in Wednesday's 2-2 Champions League draw at Sporting, but manager Mauricio Pochettino said a decision on his availability would be made closer to kickoff.
"We don't know," Pochettino said. "He's affected by a virus from Portugal. He finished the game a little bit with a problem and today he could not be part of the training session.
"We'll see during the day and tomorrow how he wakes up. We're not going to take any risks. When this type of situation happens, you don't feel right. We are going to pay attention, but still we have decided nothing."
Pochettino is preparing for his first home game since taking charge a week ago following a spell as United States coach.
The Argentine is still searching for his first victory after the dramatic draw in Lisbon and a 4-0 Premier League thrashing by Liverpool last weekend, although United were encouraged by their improved display in Portugal.
"We arrive full of energy, positive, but it's difficult for the players when the results haven't been up to scratch. We try to help them as best we can," Pochettino said of his first week in charge.
"This is a group of players who want to do well, who want to perform. Our job is to build confidence."
Speculation had been swirling around Fernandes' future in Manchester amid reports he had turned down two new contract offers. The Portugal midfielder said on Tuesday that contract talks could wait until results improve.
"I'm more worried about getting results, trying to bring the club back in a position to be proud of," he said.

FAST

SANTIAGO, Nov 27 : Chile's competition authority (FNE) asked the country's antitrust court on Friday to fine Apple about $80 million and order corrective measures for abusing its dominant position in the iOS operating system market.
• The regulator said the US technology firm has restricted competition in app distribution and in-app payments for digital goods on iOS since at least 2019
• The fine sought is equivalent to 30 per cent of sales from the product lines and services linked to the infringement during the period investigated, the FNE said on X
• "The FNE verified that Apple has prevented the sideloading of applications and alternative app stores from web browsers on iPhone devices, forcing developers and consumers to rely exclusively on the App Store," it said

Today's biggest winners and losers in the stock market.

On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Nvidia (NVDA) shares are higher even though news broke this morning that a pair of Chinese firms installed Nvidia Corp's powerful Blackwell semiconductors in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang. The gear installed at the Yangtze River Delta Project included a GB300 NVL72 rack, among Nvidia's most powerful products, according to a serial number specified in documents submitted to Chinese regulators.

- Altria (MO) shares are declining after the company issued a statement on Nov. 26 confirming early media speculation that it is considering an all cash offer for British cigarette maker Imperial Brands.

How Turkey cited India-made BrahMos to take aim at Cyprus in letter to UNSC, UNGA members

In letter to UNSC and UNGA members on 4 Nov, Turkey argued that Cyprus’s expanding military cooperation with foreign powers was undermining stability in the Eastern Mediterranean.

Debdutta Chakraborty

27 November, 2026 07:56 pm IST

New Delhi: Cyprus and India’s growing defence partnership has become the latest source of friction between New Delhi and Ankara, with Turkey raising concerns at the United Nations Security Council over the speculated sale of Indian-made BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles to the Mediterranean island.

No formal agreement for the sale of BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles has been announced as yet.

In a letter circulated to members of the UNSC and UNGA on 4 November, Turkey argued that Cyprus’s expanding military cooperation with foreign powers was undermining stability in the Eastern Mediterranean. It singled out, among other developments, procurement of BrahMos missiles.

Show Full Article

“Greek Cypriot leader Nikos Christodoulides’ visit to New Delhi in May 2026 resulted in the strengthening of bilateral strategic relations and reported arrangements concerning the procurement of BrahMos supersonic missiles with an estimated range of 650 km,” read the letter.

Issued by Murat Soysal, representing the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, the self-declared state in the island’s north recognised only by Ankara, the letter goes on to argue that, by opening the island to military facilities and operations involving the United States, Israel and France, the “Greek Cypriot administration” has “effectively turned Cyprus into a military hub serving the strategic interests of external powers and drawn it closer to conflicts beyond the region”.

It accused the Republic of Cyprus, which Turkey refers to as the “Greek Cypriot administration”, of disrupting regional stability through what it described as unilateral, bilateral and multilateral military activities.

Turkey alleged in its letter to the UNSC that BrahMos negotiations followed a visit to New Delhi in May 2026 by Cypriot President Nikos Christodoulides, during which the two countries sought to deepen their strategic partnership. New Delhi has increasingly engaged with countries in the Mediterranean including Cyprus, Greece, Armenia and Egypt through defence diplomacy, military exercises and potential arms exports.

For India, these partnerships offer opportunities to expand its defence exports, diversify strategic relationships and establish a larger presence in regions beyond its immediate neighbourhood.

For Ankara, however, some of these relationships carry a more direct security implication. India’s defence cooperation with Armenia has been a particular source of concern for Turkey and its close regional ally, Azerbaijan. Since 2022, Armenia has emerged as a significant destination for Indian military equipment, including Akash air defence systems and Pinaka multiple-launch rocket systems.

The deterioration in India-Turkey relations was also shaped by Ankara’s support for Pakistan during the military confrontation between India and Pakistan following the Pahalgam terror attack and India’s decision to target terror infrastructure in Pakistan in response.

Reports of Pakistan using Turkish-origin kamikaze drones during the conflict were criticised in New Delhi. India’s expanding defence relationships with Armenia, Greece and Cyprus have also since become part of a wider strategic conversation about competing partnerships taking shape across the region.

Also Read: India-Cyprus elevate ties to strategic partnership, announce defence roadmap & connectivity dialogue

Why Cyprus matters
The dispute over Cypriot territories is rooted in one of the Mediterranean’s longest-running political conflicts.

The island, located at the crossroads of Europe, Asia and West Asia has a predominantly Greek Cypriot population and a Turkish Cypriot minority. Its modern political history has been shaped by competing national aspirations, communal violence and repeated failures to negotiate a lasting settlement.

Cyprus gained independence from British colonial rule in 1960 under a constitutional arrangement designed to share power between its Greek and Turkish communities.

The crisis deepened in July 1974, when a coup backed by the Greek military junta sought to unite Cyprus with Greece, under a policy that came to be known as enosis . Turkey subsequently launched a military intervention, invoking its responsibilities under the 1960 Treaty of Guarantee. The treaty was signed by Cyprus, Turkey, Greece and the United Kingdom to safeguard the constitutional framework of the newly independent Republic of Cyprus. It prohibited both the island’s union with another state ( enosis ) and its partition ( taksim ). 

It also designated Turkey, Greece and Britain as guarantor powers, granting them a conditional right to intervene if the treaty’s provisions were violated.

The intervention resulted in the division of the island. Large numbers of Greek Cypriots fled or were displaced from the north, while Turkish Cypriots moved from the south. Turkish forces continue to maintain a military presence in the northern part of the island.

In 1983, the northern part of the island declared itself the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, a state recognised only by Turkey.

The internationally-recognised Republic of Cyprus joined the European Union in 2004, although the EU’s body of law remains suspended in the northern part of the island, where the government in Nicosia does not exercise effective control.

Efforts to reunify the island have repeatedly failed. A United Nations-backed settlement proposal, known as the Annan Plan, was approved by Turkish Cypriots but rejected by Greek Cypriots in separate referendums in 2004.

The unresolved conflict continues to shape the island’s security policy and its relationship with Ankara.  

Meanwhile, India’s growing engagement with Cyprus and Greece comes at a time when the Eastern Mediterranean has become an increasingly important arena for defence cooperation, energy competition and strategic diplomacy. 

Israel, which has developed a close defence-industrial relationship with India, is another important partner in the region. India has also strengthened its engagement with Greece and Egypt through diplomatic exchanges and military cooperation.

(Edited by Amrtansh Arora)

items.body:

Altria's Latest Takeover Plans Raise Big Dividend Question 1 min read

MO
Altria Group MO has confirmed that it is considering a potential all-cash offer for British tobacco giant Imperial Brands (IMBBY), setting the stage for a possible industry shakeup as traditional cigarette manufacturers look for new avenues to sustain earnings growth.
For Altria investors, the potential acquisition raises important questions about the company's international expansion strategy, debt levels and ability to maintain its generous dividend payments.
Altria generates most of its revenue from tobacco products, including its flagship Marlboro cigarette brand in the United States. Imperial Brands, meanwhile, owns internationally recognized cigarette brands including Davidoff, West and Gauloises.
Combining the two businesses could give Altria greater geographical diversification and reduce its reliance on a shrinking U.S. cigarette market. Altria also confirmed that it is discussing the potential sale of part of Imperial Brands' business to a third party, although no agreement has been reached.
Meanwhile, Reuters reported that Japan Tobacco is also exploring a potential bid, raising the possibility of competition for the British tobacco manufacturer. Imperial Brands confirmed that it had not received a formal proposal from Altria.
Under British takeover regulations, Altria has until Dec. 24 to announce a firm offer or abandon its pursuit, unless regulators grant an extension.
The development follows an impressive run for Altria stock, which has gained approximately 32% in 2026. The company also raised its dividend for the 57th consecutive year.
Investors Takeaway
For Altria's income-focused shareholders, the biggest concern is how a potentially expensive acquisition could affect future dividend growth.
An all-cash transaction could require substantial borrowing, increasing interest expenses and potentially limiting shareholder returns.
Investors should closely monitor the proposed acquisition price, financing arrangements, debt-to-EBITDA ratio and management's dividend commitments.
Moreover, a competing bid from Japan Tobacco could make the acquisition more expensive, weakening its financial appeal.
The Dec. 24 deadline represents the next major catalyst for shareholders. Until Altria reveals its proposed financial terms, determining whether the acquisition would create meaningful shareholder value remains difficult.

items.title: Déficit comercial de EE.UU. se dispara 10,7% en octubre y alcanza máximo desde marzo de 2025
items.author: Jeffrey Sparshott
items.summary: El déficit de mercancías aumentó 10,7% en octubre, por encima de los US$136.000 millones que esperaban los economistas. Las importaciones de bienes de capital marcaron un nuevo récord.
items.body: Bloomberg — El déficit comercial de mercancías de Estados Unidos se amplió en octubre por cuarto mes consecutivo, a medida que las importaciones de bienes de capital seguían creciendo. El déficit comercial de mercancías se amplió un 10,7% con respecto al mes anterior, hasta alcanzar los US$149.500 millones, la cifra más elevada desde marzo de 2025, según datos del Departamento de Comercio publicados este viernes. La estimación mediana de una encuesta de Bloomberg a economistas apuntaba a un ligero aumento hasta los US$136.000 millones. Las cifras no están ajustadas a la inflación. Ver más: El consumo se estanca en EE.UU., pero la inflación mantiene bajo presión a la Fed El valor de las importaciones de mercancías aumentó un 6,1%, mientras que las exportaciones crecieron un 3,2%. Las importaciones de bienes de capital —una categoría que incluye ordenadores y accesorios, semiconductores y equipos de telecomunicaciones que impulsan la expansión de la inteligencia artificial— se dispararon un 8,5%, alcanzando un nuevo récord. Las cifras del viernes sugieren que la carrera por construir centros de datos continuó sin cesar durante el otoño. La categoría de bienes de capital ha sido, durante el último año, el principal motor del aumento del déficit comercial. El informe también mostró aumentos en otras categorías: las importaciones de bienes de consumo subieron un 2,6% y las de suministros industriales, un 6%. Las exportaciones registraron un aumento generalizado, liderado por los automóviles. Ver más: Trump califica de “falsas” las cifras del PIB de EE.UU. y exige una investigación Por su parte, las cifras sobre las existencias minoristas, publicadas junto con los datos del comercio de bienes, mostraron un aumento del 0,8% en octubre. Las existencias mayoristas avanzaron un 0,9%. Ambas registraron su mayor incremento desde julio. Los datos sobre el comercio y los existencias servirán de base para la estimación del Gobierno sobre el producto interior bruto del cuarto trimestre. Antes de conocerse estas últimas cifras, una encuesta de Bloomberg a economistas apuntaba a que el PIB crecería a un ritmo anualizado del 2,6% durante los tres últimos meses del año. El 8 de diciembre se publicarán las cifras comerciales mensuales más completas, que incluyen el saldo de la balanza de servicios y las cifras ajustadas a la inflación del comercio de mercancías. Billionaire Carl Icahn Faces Looming $1.4 Billion Problem 1 min read

IEP CVI MPC
Legendary activist investor Carl Icahn is facing one of the toughest stretches of his investing career as mounting debt pressures and declining energy investments threaten the financial stability of his business empire, Icahn Enterprises IEP .
Icahn's fortune has dwindled to approximately $1.2 billion, according to Seeking Alpha, a dramatic reversal for an investor who spent decades building one of Wall Street's most formidable investment businesses.
Icahn Enterprises is a diversified holding company with investments across energy, automotive, real estate and other industries. Its financial performance depends heavily on the operating results and market value of its underlying investments.
The company's most pressing challenge is refinancing $1.4 billion in bonds due in May 2027.
Earlier this month, Icahn Enterprises warned that it could not guarantee refinancing the debt on acceptable terms. Yields on those bonds have climbed above 14%, compared with roughly 6% three months earlier.
Compounding its financial troubles, the company's private investment vehicles suffered a staggering 31% loss during the third quarter.
Meanwhile, shares of CVR Energy CVI , one of Icahn's largest investments, have tumbled roughly 40% since the company agreed to acquire two oil refineries from Marathon Petroleum MPC in a $4.2 billion transaction.
The selloff has further complicated Icahn's financial position, with approximately $1.3 billion in personal loans largely secured by his Icahn Enterprises holdings.
Investors Takeaway
For Icahn Enterprises investors, the immediate concern is no longer simply investment performance but financial flexibility.
Refinancing at substantially higher interest rates could further squeeze cash flow and threaten future shareholder distributions.
Investors should closely monitor refinancing negotiations, asset sales, liquidity levels and CVR Energy's refinery acquisition financing.
A recovery in CVR Energy shares could provide some financial breathing room. However, continued investment losses could leave Icahn Enterprises with fewer attractive options for raising capital ahead of its May debt deadline.

Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up at Shanghai data centre linked to Alice Huang

The submissions reveal for the first time that Nvidia’s Blackwell processors found their way into a Chinese data center that has ties to Alice Huang and Megaspeed.

Andy Lin
,  Mackenzie Hawkins
 and  Kari Lindberg

27 November, 2026 07:49 pm IST

Follow Us:

-->

Facebook

X

LinkedIn

WhatsApp

Email

Copy Link

Representative image

Stay updated with ThePrint:

Preferred Source

Google Discover

-->

A pair of Chinese firms installed Nvidia Corp.’s powerful Blackwell semiconductors in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, the woman at the heart of a controversy surrounding the US chipmaker.

The gear installed at the Yangtze River Delta Project included a GB300 NVL72 rack, among Nvidia’s most powerful products, according to a serial number specified in documents submitted to Chinese regulators in November. Shanghai Shuoyao offered the hardware as collateral to obtain a 96 million yuan ($14 million) loan from Shanghai Innovation Bank, according to filings from the lender that were reviewed by Bloomberg News.

A second firm Shanghai Kezhan, controlled by a Tokyo-based parent, described a GB200 server — which also relies on Blackwell chips — at the facility. That description was provided in documents when it obtained a 90 million yuan loan in late 2025 from a finance-leasing firm wholly owned by a local Shanghai government agency.

Show Full Article

The submissions reveal for the first time that Nvidia’s Blackwell processors found their way into a Chinese data center that has ties to Alice Huang and Megaspeed. These processors were until recently Nvidia’s most powerful data center products, and they’ve always been illegal to ship to China without a US license.

President Donald Trump has explicitly said he doesn’t want these chips — which OpenAI and Anthropic PBC use to train their most cutting-edge models — going to the Asian country, at least for now. Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, meanwhile, once claimed they were too big to smuggle: a standard two-meter-tall GB300 NVL72 server rack, which contains 72 Blackwell Ultra chips and 36 Grace processors, can weigh more than 1,500 kilograms (3,300 pounds) and is about the size of a gigantic fridge.

Nvidia and its just-reinstated CEO have come under intense scrutiny in recent weeks for their failure to stop diversion of the company’s products to China, a shadow trade that US officials believe is worth billions of dollars.

It’s unclear how the GB300 rack made its way to the country, to Shanghai Shuoyao or to this specific site — described in local media as designed to house as many as 800,000 servers. By inputting the serial number for the product into a public warranty database, Bloomberg found that it was manufactured by Taiwan’s Gigabyte Technology Co., which assembles Nvidia chips into servers and racks. The database also provided a model name for the serial number, which matches a GB300 NVL72 server rack manufactured by the Taiwanese company.

This sort of gear often passes through several hands — including local distribution networks — before it’s installed in data centers. In many cases, products that were ultimately smuggled into China were originally sold to parties in unrestricted areas. 
Bloomberg provided the rack’s serial number to Gigabyte, seeking information about to whom Gigabyte had originally sold the hardware and when. It declined to answer those questions, citing company policy. The firm “conducts all business in compliance with applicable laws and regulations,” a spokesperson said in an emailed statement. “All transactions are subject to our internal compliance requirements and the relevant laws and regulations in effect at the time.”

Shanghai Shuoyao — the company that procured the GB300 rack and offered it as collateral — is active at the data center linked to Alice Huang and also has significant overlap with Singapore-based Megaspeed, which is under US investigation over concerns that it smuggled Nvidia chips to China, Bloomberg has reported. Shanghai Shuoyao, which hasn’t responded to Bloomberg queries over the past year, confirmed this month in a rare public statement that it is one of Megaspeed’s service providers, describing the partnership as “limited to ordinary commercial cooperation.”

Megaspeed, meanwhile, used a rendering of the Yangtze River Delta Project in 2024 to describe its largest data center to investors, dubbing the site a “specific area” facility in an unnamed country. Bloomberg does not have evidence that Megaspeed itself diverted Nvidia hardware there, and Megaspeed has denied wrongdoing in response to the US probe. The company has not answered repeated queries about the Yangtze River Delta Project. Nor has Nvidia, which for years insisted that there was no black market for its products and didn’t respond to questions for this story.

The Trump administration this month put Megaspeed on a US trade blacklist, citing a significant risk of involvement in chip diversion.

Alice Huang in 2023 founded Megaspeed, a so-called neocloud that won a coveted stamp of approval from Nvidia within four days of its creation, and went on to become the chipmaker’s largest Southeast Asian customer. She also has ties to a number of companies that invested in the Yangtze River Delta Project, which counts Kang Wei as its president. Kang has been introduced at times as Alice Huang’s romantic partner, people familiar with the matter said.

It’s unclear how far along operators are in meeting their overall goal for that project, which at 800,000 servers would be on par with hyperscale facilities used by companies like OpenAI. It’s also unclear what mix of servers they plan to use. The parameters they’ve outlined in construction plans reviewed by Bloomberg — specifically, the total processing power as compared to the energy input — would be extremely difficult to satisfy with chips from Chinese companies such as Huawei Technologies Co.

Still, the smuggled hardware disclosed in the filings reviewed by Bloomberg is just a fraction of what they’d need. These documents only cover hardware offered as collateral for loans — providing a small snapshot of the operators’ ambitions, while also underscoring how some Chinese financial institutions, including with government ties, were aware that restricted hardware was getting into China and willing to lend capital on those assets.

Bloomberg was unable to reach the leasing company that lent money to Shanghai Kezhan, nor Shanghai Innovation Bank, which in addition to the money it lent Shanghai Shuoyao, also provided a 200 million yuan loan to another company called Shanghai Longjie, similarly with restricted Nvidia chips as collateral.

Shanghai Longjie — which has the same parent company as Shanghai Shuoyao — disclosed in documents filed to regulators that it has servers containing Nvidia’s earlier Hopper-generation chips, which are illegal to ship to China without Washington’s permission, Bloomberg reported this month. That hardware was manufactured by Super Micro Computer Inc. and Dell Technologies Inc. It’s unclear whether the shipments had US approval.

Those aren’t the only Hopper chips at the Yangtze River Delta Project. Shanghai Kezhan, the company that described the GB200 server in filings last year, also disclosed that it has 32 servers with H200 chips there. These products had a Gigabyte prefix in their model name, but the documents didn’t include serial numbers — making them harder to trace.

Shanghai Kezhan is headquartered about half a kilometer from the Yangtze River Delta Project, at the same commercial complex where Shanghai Shuoyao solicited engineers to work on Nvidia H100 and H200 chips — two restricted models. In February 2024, both of these firms added “imports and exports” to their business activities, according to data from Qizhidao, a company information provider.

The same month, Megaspeed’s original parent — the Chinese gaming giant 7Road — obtained 16.7% of Shanghai Kezhan via a subsidiary the gaming company bought from Alice Huang in 2019. The other 83.3% of Kezhan is ultimately owned by NeXPower Japan, according to Qizhidao. Japan’s official companies registry returned only one company named NeXPower, which was established in March 2025. Caixin, a Chinese business news outlet, said the Tokyo firm is controlled by Alice Huang.

Bloomberg has been unable to reach NeXPower for comment. Chinese-speaking staffers at the firm’s registered address wouldn’t confirm that was NeXPower’s office, and shut the door after Bloomberg News asked about their relationship with Alice Huang and Shanghai Kezhan. On the intercom was a message saying they are working and will not respond to media questions. The registered address of the company’s director appeared to be a vacated residence.

In May 2025, records compiled by Big Trade Data show, Shanghai Kezhan received a shipment worth $11 million, flown from Malaysia to Shanghai Pudong International Airport with the company as consignee.

The customs document described the shipment as “storage chassis,” referring to a structure that houses components of a storage server. But the product code it was assigned to was 847150, which denotes computing servers. The shipment’s unit price was $264,108, too costly for a storage chassis — but within the price range of servers powered by Nvidia’s Hopper chips.

items.title: RBI urges banks to expedite MSME lending, reduce reliance on collateral
items.author: Aathira Varier
items.summary: The central bank has called for greater use of digital lending channels, expansion of receivables financing, and early identification and resolution of stress among MSME borrowers ...
items.body: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has urged banks to expedite credit sanctions to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and reduce their reliance on collateral, encouraging cash-flow-based lending through digital channels to improve access to finance for the sector. At the 31st meeting of the Standing Advisory Committee (SAC) on MSME credit in Kolkata, Deputy Governor Swaminathan J called for greater use of the Unified Lending Interface (ULI) and other digital channels to facilitate lending to MSMEs, the RBI said in a press release. He also emphasised the need to expand the use of the Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) for receivables financing and strengthen early identification and resolution of stress among MSME borrowers. The meeting reviewed the flow of working capital and investment credit to MSMEs, lending to first-time borrowers, and credit guarantee coverage. Discussions also covered the enhanced limit for collateral-free lending to micro and small enterprises, settlement of invoices of central public sector enterprises (CPSEs) through TReDS, and key provisions of the MSMED (Amendment) Act, 2026. Recognising the contribution of MSMEs to India's economic growth and development goals, the deputy governor also called on industry associations to actively participate in the RBI's outreach initiatives, including town halls and district-level MSME SAMVAAD meetings. Such engagements would help improve awareness of credit-related initiatives and enable industry associations to raise concerns of their members with banks, according to the RBI. The meeting was attended by representatives of the Ministry of MSME, the Department of Financial Services, select banks, Sidbi, Nabard, CGTMSE, NCGTC, KVIC, the Indian Banks' Association, and national, regional, and state-level MSME associations.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[ワシントン ２７日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２７日発表した１０月の財（モノ）の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比１０．７％（１４４億ドル）増の１４９５億ドルとなった。人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ投資の継続が急速なペースで輸入を押し上げたことから大幅に拡大し、第4・四半期も貿易が経済成長を再び押し下げる可能性がある。 

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１３３０億ドルだった。

１０月のモノの輸入は２１１億ドル増の３６５３億ドル。モノの輸出は６７億ドル増の２１５８億ドルとなった。  

米商務省は２５日、貿易が第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率を３．２１％ポイント押し下げたと発表した。ただ、この押し下げは、個人消費の堅調な伸びと、主にＡＩ関連の設備投資の増加によって十分に相殺された。  

第３・四半期のＧＤＰ改定値は年率換算で前期比４．３％増だった。速報値の３．４％増から上方修正され、３年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。

Indian police rescue dozens of Indonesians, Malaysians from cyber fraud racket

Lured to India with promises of employment and "lucrative opportunities", they were later forced to cheat victims through fake investment schemes, police said.

NEW DELHI: Police in India have said they rescued dozens of Malaysian and Indonesian nationals who were illegally confined and forced to participate in a cyber fraud operation in a suburb of national capital Delhi. 
A total of 92 Indonesians and 72 Malaysians were rescued, Delhi police said in a statement late on Thursday (Nov 26).
They were lured to India with promises of employment and "lucrative opportunities," but were later forced to participate in the scam that cheated unsuspecting people through fake investment schemes, police said.
Police have recovered more than 350 mobile phones and nearly 170 computers used in the operation, along with 26 laptops and 174 passports, the statement said.
A Malaysian national has also been arrested, police said, adding that his role and association with others in the network were under investigation.

FAST

Nov 27 : Palmeiras will seek to extend Brazilian dominance of the Copa Libertadores when they face Argentina's Estudiantes in Saturday's final when contrasting models of South American football will compete for the continent's biggest club prize.
Argentina and Brazil are level on 25 Libertadores titles each. However, if Palmeiras win, it will not only break the deadlock, but also make it eight consecutive years that a Brazilian club has lifted the trophy.
The final at the Estadio Centenario in Montevideo also revives a historic meeting at the same stadium. Estudiantes beat Palmeiras in the 1968 final on their way to three consecutive titles, before adding a fourth crown in 2009.
PALMEIRAS' ADVANTAGE

Palmeiras arrive as favourites, with the squad depth and financial strength that have made them formidable contenders in South America under Portuguese coach Abel Ferreira. 
Ferreira has won 11 trophies since taking charge in 2020 and has turned Palmeiras into one of the continent's most consistent teams. A fourth Libertadores crown would further establish the club as the leading Brazilian force of the modern era.
Palmeiras have also invested heavily while continuing to profit from the sale of academy products to Europe.
Endrick, Estevao and Allan Elias have all left in recent years, helping Palmeiras generate funds to retain and recruit experienced players such as captain Gustavo Gomez and Brazil midfielder Andreas Pereira.
Gomez provides authority at the back, while Pereira brings control and experience in midfield. 
Palmeiras' route to Montevideo has tested that experience. Goalkeeper Carlos Miguel was their semi-final hero against Fluminense, saving penalties in the shootout to send Ferreira's side through.
The Brazilian side know the demands of a one-off final at the Centenario. Palmeiras beat Flamengo there in the 2021 final, but Estudiantes' history means they are unlikely to be overawed by the occasion.
ESTUDIANTES' RESISTANCE
Estudiantes head to Uruguay as Argentina's standard-bearer, with their own history and defiance.
Coach Alexander Medina's side carry the identity of a club long associated with tactical discipline, intensity and a willingness to embrace the most difficult moments.
That character was evident in the semi-finals, when Estudiantes held Flamengo to two scoreless draws before winning the shootout at the Maracana.
Uruguay goalkeeper Fernando Muslera was the key figure, saving three penalties to take Estudiantes to the final. The 40-year-old will now play for South America's biggest club prize in his home city.
"It will be nice to return home and play the final in another temple of football like the Centenario," Muslera said after the win over Flamengo. 
Estudiantes' progress was briefly overshadowed by uncertainty surrounding the eligibility of defender Marcos Rojo.
The club sought to register him as an injury replacement after the Argentine transfer window had closed, and South American football's governing body, CONMEBOL, initially rejected the request.
The Court of Arbitration for Sport then provisionally cleared Rojo to play before the second leg against Flamengo, prompting the Brazilian club to file a protest after the match. CONMEBOL's disciplinary body ultimately rejected the protest.
Rojo's leadership and aggression could be vital against Palmeiras' attack, while Muslera gives Medina's side a goalkeeper accustomed to the pressure of decisive matches.
Saturday's final will test whether Palmeiras' resources and tournament pedigree can overcome Estudiantes' structure and competitive edge.

Source: Reuters

OSLO: Airline Norse Atlantic’s Norwegian operating unit has declared bankruptcy, the long-haul budget carrier said on Friday (Nov 27), succumbing to soaring fuel costs wrought by the war in Iran.
Norse Atlantic ASA, which is listed on the Oslo Euronext Expand bourse, and other group companies are not part of the filing and are still attempting to stay in business, the company said in a statement.
Norse Atlantic, which launched in 2022, on Nov 25 warned that its financial situation was “critical”.
The following day, it said it had suspended all flights and that the board could file for bankruptcy unless it urgently secured funding.

“The Board of Norse Atlantic Airways AS has made the difficult decision to file for bankruptcy despite extensive efforts from the company and the group to find a solution,” Norse CEO Eivind Roald said in a statement.
“The board, management and advisers of the listed entity Norse Atlantic ASA and the UK subsidiary are working to find a solution for the remaining part of the business to continue operations,” Roald said.
Earlier on Nov 27, Norse said its lessors had terminated their leasing contracts for all 12 aircraft in the carrier’s fleet, demanding that the planes be handed back, a claim contested by the company.
Norse in 2021 signed long-term leases for nine Boeing 787 Dreamliner aircraft from Ireland-based AerCap Holdings and six Dreamliners from Singapore-based BOC Aviation. It later returned three of the planes to AerCap.
“The company contests the validity of the termination notices,” Norse said in a statement.
The AerCap leases were due to run for about 12 years for each aircraft, while the BOC contracts were due to run for 16 years, according to Norse’s latest annual report.
“Although they are contesting the notices, it sounds pretty decisive. Unless successful in this, they will not be able to resume operations,” said aviation analyst John Strickland.
The global aviation industry is suffering its worst crisis since the Covid-19 pandemic as the US-Iran conflict, which began at the end of February, disrupts operations, drives up fuel prices, and sends airlines’ costs skyrocketing .

items.title: Nubank, el real y los activos brasileños se disparan con el nuevo ministro de Hacienda de Lula
items.author: Carlos Rodríguez Salcedo
items.summary: La designación de Luiz Carlos Trabuco al frente de Hacienda renueva la confianza de los inversionistas, mientras Citi advierte que el repunte deberá estar respaldado por reformas fiscales concretas.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Las acciones de Nubank ( NU ), el real brasileño ( USDBRL ) y otros activos del país se disparan este viernes después de que el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva designara al banquero Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi como nuevo ministro de Hacienda. Ver más: Del oro al cobre: BofA revela pronósticos para 2027 y sus acciones favoritas en América Latina El nombramiento del presidente del consejo de administración de Banco Bradesco renovó las expectativas de los inversionistas sobre un mayor compromiso del Gobierno con la disciplina fiscal, tras las fuertes ventas que siguieron a la reelección de Lula. Las acciones de Nu subían un 11,65% en las operaciones previas a la apertura de Wall Street, mientras el real brasileño lideraba las ganancias entre las divisas mundiales. Natalia Gurushina, estratega de mercados emergentes de VanEck, señaló que “el real brasileño y las tasas prolongaron su repunte gracias a una combinación de dos golpes de política económica (por así decirlo)”. Así se ha comportado el dólar en Brasil. Símbolo: BRL:CUR. Clase de activo: currency. La estratega explicó que “las conversaciones sobre la limitación del gasto obligatorio fueron seguidas por la elección de un ministro de Hacienda favorable al mercado”. La moneda brasileña se apreciaba un 2,80% a las 8:19 a.m., hora de Nueva York, según datos de Bloomberg. El dólar retrocedía hasta los BRL$5,50, frente a los BRL$5,66 del cierre anterior. El real llegó a ganar hasta un 3,3% durante la mañana del viernes y superaba el desempeño del peso colombiano (1,65%), el peso mexicano (0,98%) y el peso chileno (0,91%). Suscríbete al newsletter Línea de Mercado , una selección de Bloomberg Línea con las noticias bursátiles más destacadas del día. La recuperación contrasta con el deterioro que experimentó la moneda tras la segunda vuelta electoral de finales de octubre, cuando el dólar pasó de BRL$5 a BRL$6 en apenas unas semanas, según BBVA FX Strategy. La divisa brasileña ya acumulaba una apreciación semanal cercana al 5% al cierre del jueves, jornada en la que avanzó un 2,6% ante las noticias sobre Hacienda y una lectura de inflación inferior a las previsiones. El índice de precios al consumidor de mediados de noviembre registró una variación mensual del 0,22%, frente al 0,36% esperado por el consenso, aunque la tasa interanual pasó del 4,62% al 4,64%. La inflación subyacente media también sorprendió a la baja, con un incremento mensual del 0,15%, frente al 0,29% proyectado. Gurushina también valoró que “la sorpresa a la baja de la inflación de mediados de mes en Brasil es un acontecimiento positivo, aunque persisten los desafíos subyacentes”. El avance de Nubank en Nueva York coincidía con un incremento del 15% en las operaciones de premercado de un fondo cotizado (ETF) que replica las acciones brasileñas. Así se ha comportado la acción de Nubank. Símbolo: NU:UN. Clase de activo: equity. En Brasil, el Ibovespa avanzaba un 3,34% este viernes, después de cerrar el jueves con un alza del 6,07%, hasta aproximadamente 182.703,44 puntos, su mejor desempeño diario desde la primera vuelta electoral de octubre. Bradesco BBI elevó su recomendación sobre la bolsa brasileña de neutral a sobreponderar, al considerar que el nombramiento aporta la credibilidad fiscal necesaria para escapar de una potencial trampa de valor. Citi anticipa una rotación hacia compañías más sensibles a las tasas de interés domésticas, entre ellas las constructoras Cyrela y EZ Tec, así como empresas con mayor apalancamiento financiero, como Randon. Ver más: Lula nombra a Luiz Carlos Trabuco ministro de Hacienda ante el creciente déficit fiscal de Brasil Por el contrario, exportadoras como Embraer y WEG podrían registrar un desempeño relativo inferior a corto plazo ante la apreciación del real y la recomposición de las carteras. Trabuco asumirá la conducción económica de Brasil con un déficit presupuestario cercano al 10% del producto interno bruto (PIB) y una deuda pública que continúa en ascenso. “La amplia experiencia de Trabuco en el sector privado y su credibilidad ante los mercados financieros podrían ayudar a reconstruir la confianza y reducir la prima de riesgo de Brasil”, escribió André Mazini, analista de Citi. Así se ha comportado el Ibovespa. Símbolo: IBOV:IND. Clase de activo: equity. Sin embargo, el banco estadounidense advirtió sobre la posibilidad de extrapolar el repunte hacia un cambio estructural en las perspectivas económicas del país. Las expectativas de tasas de interés también registraron ajustes, con caídas de 60 puntos básicos en los contratos de swaps de largo plazo. Ver más: Activos brasileños repuntan tras nombramiento de un banquero como nuevo ministro de Hacienda BBVA FX Strategy identifica margen para movimientos adicionales en el tramo largo de la curva si el Gobierno anuncia otro paquete fiscal mediante una enmienda constitucional durante las próximas dos semanas. Para Citi, la prueba será la capacidad de Trabuco para convertir las expectativas del mercado en reformas fiscales concretas y conseguir el respaldo político necesario para su implementación.

items.title: Corus Entertainment reports $59.4M Q4 loss, revenue also lower
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Corus Entertainment Inc. reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of $59.4 million in its latest quarter as the company behind Global Television saw its revenue fall 11 per cent compared with ...
items.body: TORONTO — Corus Entertainment Inc. reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of $59.4 million in its latest quarter as the company behind Global Television saw its revenue fall 11 per cent compared with a year ago. The television and radio broadcaster says the loss amounted to 30 cents per diluted share for the quarter ended Aug. 31. The result compared with a loss of $277 million or $1.39 per diluted share for the same quarter last year. Chief executive John Gossling says the results reflected significant improvement in advertising revenue trends and the best quarterly performance year-over-year since the second quarter of fiscal 2023. On an adjusted basis, Corus says it lost 20 cents per share in its latest quarter compared with an adjusted loss of 36 cents per share a year earlier. Revenue for what was the company’s fourth quarter totalled $206.8 million, down from $232 million a year earlier. The company says it will receive $36 million as part of Ottawa’s funding support of Canadian local news sectors announced during the federal budget. Corus says the amount will be reflected in its fiscal first quarter of 2027. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 27, 2026.

［オスロ　２７日　ロイター］ - 経営危機に陥っていたノルウェーの長距離路線専門の格安航空会社（ＬＣＣ）ノース・アトランティック航空は２７日、ノルウェーの運航子会社が破産を申請したと発表した。

声明によると、ユーロネクスト・オスロ証券取引所の「ユーロネクスト・エクスパンド」市場に上場するノース・アトランティックＡＳＡとその他のグループ会社は今回の申請の対象外で、事業継続を目指している。

同社は、２５日に財務状況が「危機的」だと警告した。翌２６日には全便の運航停止を発表し、緊急に資金を確保できなければ取締役会が破産を申請する可能性があるとしていた。２７日は、自社が運航する１２機を所有する各社がリース契約を解約したと明らかにしていた。

アイビン・ロアル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「会社とグループが解決策を見つけるために多大な努力を重ねたが、ノース・アトランティック・エアウェイズＡＳの取締役会は破産申請という難しい決断を下した」と述べた。

ロアル氏はさらに「上場会社のノース・アトランティックＡＳＡと英国子会社の取締役会、経営陣、アドバイザーは、残りの事業の運航を続けるための解決策を探っている」と語った。

２月末に始まったイラン紛争で運航が混乱し、燃料価格が高騰し航空業界は打撃を受けている。長距離路線に特化したノースは、特に燃料コスト増大が痛手となった。
